annotations.title: Compare company financials side by side (SEC)

description: Compare company financials side by side (SEC) — Side-by-side annual financials for 2 to 4 US-listed companies straight from their 10-K XBRL filings: revenue, net income, net margin, diluted EPS, operating cash flow, cash, equity, return on equity and year-over-year growth, plus which company leads each metric and a revenue ranking. Price: $0.012 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: sec_compare
